name: OLX/Otomoto Ban + Viewed + Rating
description: Ban listings, rate sellers, track viewed items, and sync via GitHub Gist. Zero Google dependencies.
author: piotereks

data_collection_permissions.description: Stores ban/rating/comment data locally in IndexedDB. No data sent to Mozilla or third parties.
data_collection_permissions.why: Core functionality requires storing user actions locally. Optional GitHub Gist sync is user-initiated.
